table.retrieve:
SELECT  
	users.username, 
	salecat=saleledger.salecatcode,
	saleledger.custcode,
	headerno = dbo.saleledger.headerno,
	customer=(select name from accounts where acccode=saleledger.custcode),
	dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode,   
	altersaleinvcode=dbo.saleledger.altersaleinvcode,
	dbo.saleledger.date,   
	custrefno=dbo.saleledger.custrefno,
	billingdate=dbo.saleledger.billingdate,
	vehicle=dbo.saleledger.vehicle,
	grn=dbo.saleledger.grn,
	shipto=dbo.saleledger.shipto,
	patient=(select patient.name from patient where patient.patientcode=saleledger.patientcode),
	patientaddress=(select patient.address1 from patient where patient.patientcode=saleledger.patientcode),
	patientcity=(select patient.city from patient where patient.patientcode=saleledger.patientcode),
	patientphone=(select patient.phone from patient where patient.patientcode=saleledger.patientcode),
	salecomments1 = dbo.saleledger.salecomments1,
	salecomments2 = dbo.saleledger.salecomments2,

	dbo.saleledger.discperc,   
	dbo.saleledger.misccharges,   
	dbo.saleledger.flatdisc,   
	dbo.saleledger.salestax,   
	dbo.saleledger.custcode,   
	dbo.saleledger.remarks,   
	posted= dbo.saleledger.posted,
	cashtendered=saleledger.cashtendered,
	cashreceived=saleledger.cashcharged,
	cashback=saleledger.cashback,
	CardsCharged=ISNULL((select isnull(sum(CW.amount),0) from cashierwindow CW where CW.saleinvcode=saleledger.saleinvcode), 0),
	customername='                                  '  ,
	machinename=',' +  saleledger.machinename,
	reprintcounter=dbo.saleledger.reprintingcounter,
	InvTotal = dbo.saleledger.InvTotal,
	altersaleinvcode= dbo.saleledger.altersaleinvcode,
	associatedamt= 0.00,
	balance=0.00,
	CreditCardAmt = ISNULL((SELECT SUM(CashierWindow.Amount) FROM CashierWindow, Accounts WHERE Accounts.AccCode = CashierWindow.AccCode and CashierWindow.SaleInvCode = saleledger.saleinvcode), 0)
FROM 
	dbo.saleledger,   
	Users 
WHERE 
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode >= :ar_SInvCode ) AND
	( dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode <= :ar_LInvCode ) AND
	( saleLedger.SalesManCode = users.userCode )
ORDER BY
	saleledger.saleinvcode
